description: This is a test class for the LeaveReportDataAPI, specifically testing the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageLeaveReportDataAPI. The class contains setup methods and multiple test cases for API endpoints related to leave report data, including methods for retrieving all report data, and placeholders for delete, create, and validation rules testing.
